solicitudContacto.asunto: {empresa} wants to get in touch with you on ApoyaClub
solicitudContacto.titulo: {empresa} wants to get in touch with {club}
solicitudContacto.sobreElClub: About your club in general (no specific opportunity).
solicitudContacto.boton: See and reply in your dashboard
solicitudContacto.pie: ApoyaClub only puts the two sides in touch: the conversation and any agreement are handled directly between the club and the business.

caducidadSuscripcion.asunto: {dias, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} until your ApoyaClub subscription expires
caducidadSuscripcion.titulo: {dias, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} until {club} loses visibility
caducidadSuscripcion.texto: You have cancelled your subscription and on {fecha} you’ll lose access: your public page and your opportunities will no longer be visible to businesses (your data isn’t deleted).
caducidadSuscripcion.texto2: If it was a mistake or you want to carry on, you can reactivate it at any time before that date.

contactoLanding.eyebrow: New message from the ApoyaClub contact form

bienvenidaClub.texto: You have a free month to get everything ready. In three steps you’ll have something to show a business:
bienvenidaClub.textoPiloto: You have 6 months free to get everything ready and try it out properly. In three steps you’ll have something to show a business:
bienvenidaClub.paso1: Upload your logo and a photo, and say in two lines who you are.
bienvenidaClub.paso2: Add your teams and your youth team and audience figures: it’s what a business looks at.
bienvenidaClub.paso3: Create your first sponsorship opportunity, even if it’s just €50.
bienvenidaClub.pie: When it’s ready, share your link on WhatsApp with local businesses: that’s what works best.

bienvenidaEmpresa.titulo: Find clubs near you and sponsor from €50
bienvenidaEmpresa.texto: Access is free and we don’t charge commission: you deal directly with the club. You can filter by sport, distance, budget and goal.
bienvenidaEmpresa.pie: If you complete your business profile, it’s much easier for the club to reply to you.

respuestaDelClub.eyebrow: News about your request on ApoyaClub
respuestaDelClub.tituloDescartada: {club} has closed your request for now
respuestaDelClub.textoConversacion: The club has marked your request as “in conversation”. From here you carry on between yourselves: ApoyaClub isn’t involved in the agreement.
respuestaDelClub.textoDescartada: It doesn’t always fit: it may be down to dates, budget or the opportunity already being taken. There are more clubs looking for sponsors near you.

solicitudSinAbrir.asunto: {total, plural, one {You have # unopened request} other {You have # unopened requests}}
solicitudSinAbrir.titulo: {total, plural, one {# business has written to you and is still waiting for a reply} other {# businesses have written to you and are still waiting for a reply}}
solicitudSinAbrir.texto: The oldest has been waiting {dias, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. Replying quickly is the difference between a sponsorship and a forgotten email.

finDePrueba.asunto: {dias, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left of your free trial on ApoyaClub
finDePrueba.titulo: {dias, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} of trial left for {club}
finDePrueba.texto: On {fecha} your subscription will start, on the plan you chose. You don’t need to do anything to continue; if you’d rather not carry on, you can cancel from your dashboard before that date and you won’t be charged.
finDePrueba.textoSinTarjeta: Your free trial ends on {fecha}. To keep using your dashboard and keep your club visible, choose a plan before that date: from €199/year, VAT included. If you don’t choose one, your page stops being shown, but nothing is deleted: you can come back whenever you like.

fichaIncompleta.asunto: Your profile is {porcentaje}% complete and that costs you visibility
fichaIncompleta.texto: Clubs with the most complete profiles appear first in search. What you’re missing most right now:
fichaIncompleta.cierre: It takes ten minutes and you only have to do it once.

avisoPatrocinador.asunto: {club} has added you as a sponsor on its page
avisoPatrocinador.texto: {club} has created its sponsorship page and included you among the businesses that support it. Thank you for being there: without businesses like yours, many grassroots clubs wouldn’t make it to the end of the season.
avisoPatrocinador.texto2: On its page you can see how you appear, with your logo and your sponsor category. It’s public, so you can share it too.
avisoPatrocinador.pieMotivo: You’re receiving this email because {club} has listed you as one of its sponsors and provided this address. It’s sent by the club through ApoyaClub, the tool it uses to manage its page. This is a one-off notice: we won’t write to you again. If you’d rather be removed from its page, reply to this email and the club will take care of it.

necesidadesQueEncajan.asunto: {cuantas, plural, one {A club is looking for what you offer} other {# clubs are looking for what you offer}}
necesidadesQueEncajan.titulo: {cuantas, plural, one {A club is looking for this} other {These # clubs are looking for something you offer}}
necesidadesQueEncajan.texto: They’ve been published on ApoyaClub and match what {empresa} offers. If any of them interests you, write to them directly: you don’t need anything prepared.
necesidadesQueEncajan.yMas: {cuantas, plural, one {And # more is waiting.} other {And # more are waiting.}}
necesidadesQueEncajan.boton: See everything clubs are looking for
necesidadesQueEncajan.pie: You’re receiving this because you published what your business offers on ApoyaClub. You can stop receiving these notices whenever you like: {enlaceBaja}
